embeds.title: 🔴 Unpatched ChromaDB Flaw Leaves Servers Open to Remote Code Execution
embeds.description:
Researchers at HiddenLayer published details about CVE-2026-45829, a critical vulnerability in ChromaDB versions 1.0.0 through 1.5.8 that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. The flaw stems from a race condition where authentication checks occur after malicious model configurations are fetched and executed from Hugging Face. HiddenLayer reports that over 73% of publicly accessible ChromaDB instances on the internet are running vulnerable versions.
**Sources:** CSO Online • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-45829 • **Access:** Unauthenticated API request to ChromaDB server with malicious model configuration hosted on Hugging Face
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** claim
[Read source](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4175958/unpatched-chromadb-flaw-leaves-servers-open-to-remote-code-execution.html)
